title: Google\Cloud\Spanner\V1\KeySet
name: KeySet
description: KeySet defines a collection of Cloud Spanner keys and/or key ranges. All the keys are expected to be in the same table or index. The keys need not be sorted in any particular way.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.keys
params.description: A list of specific keys. Entries in keys should have exactly as many elements as there are columns in the primary or index key with which this KeySet is used. Individual key values are encoded as described [here][google.spanner.v1.TypeCode].

params.name: data.ranges
params.description: A list of key ranges. See [KeyRange][google.spanner.v1.KeyRange] for more information about key range specifications.

params.name: data.all
params.description: For convenience all can be set to true to indicate that this KeySet matches all keys in the table or index. Note that any keys specified in keys or ranges are only yielded once.
